description: Header file defining internal utility functions and types for ANGLE's feature support, including API versioning, rules parsing, system info management, and application usage decisions.
external_methods: ANGLE_EXPORT bool ANGLEAndroidParseRulesString(const char *, RulesHandle *, int *)
ANGLE_EXPORT bool ANGLEAddDeviceInfoToSystemInfo(const char *, const char *, SystemInfoHandle)
ANGLE_EXPORT bool ANGLEShouldBeUsedForApplication(const RulesHandle, int, const SystemInfoHandle, const char *)

methods.name: ANGLEGetFeatureSupportUtilAPIVersion
methods.description: Determines the supported API version for the feature support utility.

methods.name: ANGLEAndroidParseRulesString
methods.description: Parses a rules string to create a rules handle and determine rules version.

methods.name: ANGLEGetSystemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to the system information structure.

methods.name: ANGLEAddDeviceInfoToSystemInfo
methods.description: Adds device manufacturer and model info to the system info handle.

methods.name: ANGLEShouldBeUsedForApplication
methods.description: Decides whether to use ANGLE for a specific application based on rules and system info.
